key_path: Sign up at platform.claude.com (email magic link or Google)
Phone verification by SMS to claim the one-time $5 credit (optional per support article; VoIP numbers rejected)
Add a card and buy prepaid credits (minimum $5), which the API needs to serve requests
Settings > API keys > Create key (pick personal or service-account key, expiration, workspace)
OR skip the key: `ant auth login` (browser OAuth, `--no-browser` for headless) and call the API with a workspace-scoped token

agent_native_auth.cli_login_browser_or_device: yes. `ant auth login` runs browser OAuth against the Console and stores a workspace-scoped token, so 'call the API without creating or managing an API key'. `--no-browser` handles remote hosts, `--scope org:admin` gives an admin profile, and named profiles are supported
agent_native_auth.oauth_dynamic_client_registration: no public DCR for the API (the CLI uses a first-party client_id)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no. The docs say outright that the Admin API 'can't ... give you a key to call the Claude API with'. Admin keys list, update and disable keys only. Workload Identity Federation issues short-lived credentials for workloads
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes. Personal, service-account and workspace keys, workspace scoping, expiration
agent_native_auth.free_credits_or_tier: small one-time $5 after phone verification (support article; may be stale), otherwise prepaid

docs_mcp.scope: docs search. Found by probing; not listed in llms.txt

mcp.product_mcp: none for Console or account operations. Anthropic consumes MCP (MCP connector, MCP tunnels, Managed Agents)
mcp.one_click_install: none found for its own docs MCP

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://platform.claude.com/llms.txt (docs.anthropic.com and docs.claude.com serve the same file)
docs_for_agents.openapi: no public spec URL found (SDKs and the ant CLI are generated)
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: claude-api skill / Agent Skills; CLI scripting page covers use from Claude Code

score_justification: `ant auth login` gives an agent keyless, workspace-scoped OAuth (headless too), but there is prepaid billing, no key-minting API and no product MCP.
best_practice: A keyless CLI OAuth login (`ant auth login --no-browser`) that issues a workspace-scoped token, so an agent never handles a long-lived secret.
biggest_gap: Credits must be bought before the first call, and the Admin API deliberately can't mint usable keys.
notes_out_of_date: Third-party guides still describe the $5 phone-claim credit; check before relying on it.
